This is the official video guide on how to use Search Nearby with Galaxy SmartTag3. Compass View provides distance and direction guidance to help you close in on belongings, ideal for locating items quickly. If an object remains hidden, ring Galaxy SmartTag3 and follow the sound to pinpoint its exact location. Learn more: http://smsng.co/SmartTag3_HowTo_SearchNearby_yt

00:00 Intro
00:10 Get guided with Compass View

Follow these simple steps to use Search Nearby:

Step 1: Open the SmartThings app and select Galaxy SmartTag3.
Step 2: Tap 'View map' and 'Search Nearby.'
Step 3: Follow the distance and direction guidance to move closer to your belongings.
Step 4: If it’s still hard to spot, ring Galaxy SmartTag3 and follow the sound to pinpoint its location.

This is the official video guide on how to set up Galaxy SmartTag3 and start locating your belongings swiftly with ease. Connect to the SmartThings app to see where your things are on the map, look back up to 7 days of location history, and customize useful settings to fit your everyday needs. So whether it’s your keys, bag, or luggage, you can spend less time searching and more time getting on with your day. Learn more: http://smsng.co/SmartTag3_Howto_GetStarted_yt

Follow these simple steps to set up and locate Galaxy SmartTag3:

Step 1: Remove the battery film to activate Galaxy SmartTag3.
Step 2: Follow the pop-up on your phone to connect Galaxy SmartTag3 to the SmartThings app.
Step 3: Tap 'View map' to check the location of your belongings.
Step 4: Customize settings such as smart button action, ringtone and volume, and Power Saving Mode.
